summary: Comprehensive E2E test of Zynthoro batch fixes 4-13. Backend: 44 passed, 1 skipped (full regression 40/1 + new test_team_level.py 4/0 for FIX 7 plan-based level enforcement). Frontend: All 10 fixes verified end-to-end via Playwright on the public preview URL. Founder plan and 2FA flipped via mongosh (Starter <-> Enterprise Unlimited, billing_exempt true/false) to drive gating paths; all paths restored before finish.

ui_bugs.issue: When current plan is 'Starter' (or 'Creator'/'Presale' — anything without a SEAT_PRICE entry) the dialog falls into the else branch and renders 'Your Enterprise plan includes unlimited seats — no extra purchase needed.' That message is wrong for a Starter user. Should either hide the 'Buy extra seats' button on Starter/Creator, or display a 'Upgrade to Business to add seats' copy.

Enterprise savings row says 'from €2.499/month' (EU decimal dot). Spec wording said 'from €2,499/month' (comma). Cosmetic — number is correct, just the locale separator differs. Decide on a single locale convention.

Footnote text content starts with '* ' then bold 'Starter is your foundation'. Spec said the footnote should start with 'Starter is your foundation'. Visible text is correct apart from the leading asterisk marker; consider removing the '* ' or moving it to a superscript ref.

action_items: Fix Team.jsx Buy-seats dialog: render an upgrade-prompt copy for Starter/Creator instead of the Enterprise wording. Or hide the 'Buy extra seats' button when SEAT_PRICE[plan] is undefined and plan is not Enterprise.
(Optional) Standardise EU number formatting in PricingComparisonTables.jsx Enterprise row to match spec (€2,499 vs €2.499).
(Optional) Remove leading '* ' from the italic footnote so the visible text starts with 'Starter is your foundation' per spec.
critical_code_review_comments: Team.jsx SEAT_PRICE dict only has Business/Agency entries — the else branch hard-codes an Enterprise message which leaks to all other plans. Use an explicit plan-class check (e.g. plan.startsWith('Enterprise')) or a switch on plan for safe defaults.

MarketingContent.jsx plan-gating correctly defers to planAtLeast() helpers from planCatalog.js — verified via Starter run: only Facebook/Instagram unlocked, LinkedIn/TikTok/X/YouTube show 'Creator+'. Calendar/Photo/Video/Campaigns/Analytics/Clients all show correct upgrade-lock with the correct CTA (creator/business/agency).

ChangePlanDialog.jsx behaviour is exactly per spec: current-plan card has 'Current' badge + disabled 'Your plan' button, non-current cards show 'Coming soon' enabled, clicking them only toasts. No Stripe call fires.

Backend team_invite enforces PLAN_MAX_LEVEL correctly: Starter user invited at level=3 OK, level=10 returns 403 with detail 'Your Starter plan only allows members up to level 3...'. Pydantic field validation rejects level>10 with 422.
PricingComparisonTables uses EU dot decimal (€2.499) while spec asked for comma (€2,499). Pick one and apply across the app.

rca of the issue: Buy-extra-seats Starter wording: Team.jsx const SEAT_PRICE = { Business: 4.99, Agency: 3.99 }. For Starter/Creator/Presale, seatPrice is undefined, so the ternary `seatPrice ? <chips/> : <enterprise message/>` falls through to the Enterprise copy. Fix: either gate the button display on (seatPrice || plan.startsWith('Enterprise')) and hide for Starter/Creator, or split the else into two branches based on plan.startsWith('Enterprise').
